name: Huldah
description: Prophetess living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: If you know the history, King Josiah discovered the book of the law and they started to read it. They read it to understand what they was doing wrong and in error and how they can fix it. And the Lord used Huldah.
Hilkiah and the king's men go to Huldah the prophetess, who dwells in Jerusalem in the college; there were women among the people who were prophetesses, known by their works.

note.label: 2 Kings 22: Josiah and the Book of the Law

points: Huldah was a prophetess, and a prophetess is a female prophet.

note.label: 7 WOMAN SHALL TAKE HOLD OF ONE MAN

points: Hilkiah and the men go to Huldah the prophetess, wife of Shallum, who dwells in the college in Jerusalem, and she declares the word of the Lord God of Israel.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 34: Josiah the Wise Child Finds the Book of the Law
